Russell Brand's rape trial hears from a former assistant, No 10 plays down joining the EU single market, and about 90,000 properties remain without power after two storms.
text.us: Benjamin Netanyahu seeks a new mandate in Israel's first election since the 7 October 2023 Hamas attacks. Five charts set out the US economy under Trump before the midterms, and Anthropic's stock market filing shows fast revenue growth and larger losses. Lula vows no return to dictatorship in Brazil, Anthropic's Claude bypasses a paywall to reach Georgia voter data, and Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish officials visit Iran to avert a flare-up.
text.au: The EPA warns that Woodside's proposed gasfield in WA risks an oil spill and threatens endangered turtles, coral and pygmy blue whales. Jacinda Ardern joins the University of Sydney as a lecturer, and Angus Taylor faces criticism over his response to the alleged attack on Helen Haines. Queensland cuts funding to a children's legal centre that criticised the government, and Serbia weighs its next steps after a student-led movement ousts Vučić.
